text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first race of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho, is about to start when Fuji Kiseki suddenly gets a phone call.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She picks up to find herself greeted with cheers from her dorm residents. She heads off for the race, heart bolstered by their sweet surprise.
